definition: the way everything is arranged in its place
description: An attic with wooden beams, a skylight and a work lamp. A large model railway fills a big table: tiny fields, hedges, houses, a tunnel and a station are carefully arranged, and a red steam train puffs smoke as it crosses a stone viaduct and disappears. In the foreground two hands with mint nail polish and lilac sleeves set a small fir tree onto a green hill. A young man in navy dungarees leans across the table, places a tiny piece on the far side and looks up with a smile.

taps.phrase: to place a miniature fir tree

en.question: What is the man leaning across?

de.answer: Er beugt sich über eine Modelleisenbahnanlage.

es.answer: Se está inclinando sobre una maqueta de tren.
